title: Unify MCP skills with catalog revisions
objective: Ensure MCP prompt/resource additions, updates, and removals participate in the same identity, digest, and revision model as filesystem skills.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid skill catalog design in the dirty shared worktree.
Registry state is authoritative; prompt messages are an append-only model projection and never the authorization boundary.

source_evidence.note: Bounded metadata catalog and on-demand full skill content.
Live discovery and four-state skill visibility controls.
Append-only messages preserve the prior cached prefix.

include: Assign stable source-aware IDs and virtual locators to MCP skills.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Adapt MCP stores to expose revision inputs without editing Manager-owned files.
Verify remote content digest is based on the invoked markdown.
acceptance_criteria: MCP removal can become a catalog revoke.
MCP and local same-name skills remain distinct.
No network calls are required in tests.
dispatch_prompt: Integrate MCP skill sources with the stable identity/digest/revision contract. Modify only the two owned MCP production files and a new test.
notes_for_assignee: Respect owned_files. Escalate contract gaps to the integration owner rather than editing another task's production files.
